acquisition_note: Acquired by scripts/acquire_pvgis_monthly_ghi_benchmarks.py directly from the PVGIS endpoint recorded above. candidate_year_note: This fold has two candidate years (FINDING EU-S2-03). A benchmark is per fold-year; acquiring both does not choose between them. Year selection is a diary question and the diary is GSSCanada-owned.
monthly_ghi_order_note: Index 0 is January; the gate reads exactly twelve ordered values.
